name: refresh_wiki_page
description: Refresh one entity's wiki page from current KG state. Use after KG mutations that change the facts the page rendered (e.g. closed a State, added an Event, renamed a node). Wraps wiki_generator.growth.build_one_page; runs the consistency critic by default. Synchronous; takes ~10-30s while the LLM rewrites affected sections.

inputs.name: entity_label
inputs.description: Exact label of the entity (e.g. 'Annika'). Must match an existing wiki page or KG node eligible for one.

inputs.name: run_critic
inputs.description: Whether to run the wiki_consistency_critic after writing the page. Default true.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the refresh is needed (audit context).

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for refresh_wiki_page:
- entity_label (required): the entity whose page needs refreshing
- run_critic (optional, default true): run the wiki consistency critic after
- reason (optional)
